meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构搜索并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要跨文件修改同一类代码结构。
copy.tagline_en: Search code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to modify the same kind of code structure across files.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把代码问题当作“结构形状”来处理：能按函数、调用、类、导入等形状查找代码，并执行批量改写（如统一日志、替换导入）。改写前会先做干运行预览，确认无误后才实际修改文件。
howto.when: 当你要“查找或改写某类结构的代码”时触发，例如“把所有 console.log 改成 logger.info”、“去掉所有 as any”、“把 require() 换成 import”等。

say.text: 把所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)
找到所有接受 Request 参数的函数
把 require() 换成 import，先预览再应用

howto.what_en: Claude uses AST-aware search/rewrite: matches code by structure (function, call, class, import) and runs batch rewrites (e.g., console.log→logger.info). Applies only after dry-run preview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find/rewrite structurally-shaped code, e.g., 'change all console.log to logger.info', 'strip as any', 'replace require() with import'.

say_en.text: Find all functions taking a Request parameter
Replace require() with import, preview first
